name: Nike Barcelona Kids Training Dri-Fit Strike

description.subtitle: Nike FC Barcelona children's long training pants 2026 2027 - black
description.tagline: Train like the FCB with the Mamba mentality
description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Dri-Fit Strike training pants for children are designed to offer maximum performance in each training session, inspired by the connection between Kobe Bryant and FC Barcelona. Its design reflects the constant search for excellence and accompanies each movement with total comfort.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Wicks sweat away to keep skin dry and comfortable.
Elastic fabric: Facilitates mobility in every movement.
Zippered hems: They allow you to easily put on and take off the pants without taking off your boots.
FC Barcelona Design: Inspired by the legacy of Kobe Bryant and the identity of the Barcelona club.
